The Voyage of the Demeter

“Log of the Demeter. Varna to Whitby.” The schooner’s course from the captain’s own entries, 6 July to 4 August, and the men she lost on the way.

Souls aboard
9

    the Demeter’s course a man lost

    Every date and place is the captain’s. Stoker gives only those, so the course between them — round the Morea, along the coast of Africa, up past Portugal — is the usual sailing route of the day and is drawn as such; where a man was lost between two named places, his mark sits where the dates put the ship. The paintings are the ones from the Dracula page. Relief from the Amenti atlas ground; coasts from Natural Earth.
